jobDescription: The residential lending underwriting team assesses mortgage applications against the bank's lending policy. The Mortgage Underwriting Analyst prepares the underwriting assessment for each application, verifies the income and property documents, refers cases outside policy to the senior underwriter, explains assessment outcomes to the mortgage advisers, and documents each case's open items. Lending decisions above the analyst's mandate stay with the senior underwriter. The role requires explaining declined or conditioned outcomes to advisers who push back. Reports to the underwriting team leader; works with the mortgage advisers, the valuation panel and the senior underwriters.
requirements: Prepares underwriting assessments against the lending policy under the assessment procedure.
Verifies income and property documents under the verification standard.
Explains declined or conditioned outcomes to mortgage advisers who push back, within the policy.
Refers cases outside policy or mandate to the senior underwriter and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents each case's open items and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Mortgage underwriting analyst in a retail bank's residential lending team for three years, preparing the underwriting assessments for about seven hundred applications a year against the lending policy under the assessment procedure.
Verified the income and property documents on each application under the verification standard, with the verification checklist completed on each case file.

Explained the declined and conditioned outcomes to the mortgage advisers on the adviser line, with the adviser escalations logged; eleven escalations in three years, none upheld against the assessment.
Referred the cases outside policy or above my mandate to the senior underwriter, recording the referral reason and the mandate on each case.
Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions on each case passed to another analyst or to the senior underwriter.

Work sample: two anonymised case files (assessment, verification checklist, adviser call note, referral record) and the adviser escalation log extract, with the underwriting system references as a verification trail.

Interviewer 1 note: in the adviser role-play the candidate stated the policy clause the decline rested on, listed the two documents that would reopen the case, kept the same explanation when the adviser repeated the objection, and closed by summarising the next step for the adviser.

Reference call with the former underwriting team leader: confirmed the candidate prepared the assessments and handled the adviser line in the period, that referrals above mandate went to the senior underwriter, and confirmed the employment dates.
